title: Critical recovery, query lower bounds and binary-native width
summary: Critical detecting-set counts, physical test-list and black-box query lower bounds, and critical-set and cycle recovery through a fixed source-reading program. Primal/incidence treewidth bounds concern specification and complete binary-expanded native CNF graphs; a conditional cover-layout theorem bounds treewidth, net-cutwidth and block width. Strong and deletion backdoors into Horn, renamable-Horn and two-CNF have cardinality at least the bus count for both native and specification formulas.

formalizes.title: Polynomial Fault Detection Without Bounded Width: Exact Reachable Sets in Priority Controllers

review.reason: Complexity bounds on critical recovery, query lower bounds and treewidth for CNF encodings.
